entityFieldPolicy: All ten full canonical records,20 RELATED_SEARCH aliases and empty crosswalk read. Definitions, mechanisms, types/scales, direction, modifiability/volatility, timings, measurements, caveats, sources, narratives/interactions and null metadata retained. No blocked fields repaired.
rdsReview: No Family RDS. Related PSY-078 remains external-input derived; reference point not discrepancy and no direct RDS target.
causalGateReview: Four Driver→Driver incident claims STANDARD_CAUSAL, two new primary/two F05 reused, no V3 projection count or existing change.

layersConsidered.BIO: Dopaminergic drug/PET and state arousal considered; drug effect, endogenous association, preference and capacity distinct.
layersConsidered.PSY: Reference, loss/risk/ambiguity preference, probability transformation and temporal/effort valuation distinct.
layersConsidered.SOC: Social comparison/default endorsement considered; no isolated exact social Driver effect retained.
layersConsidered.CUL: Global preference survey country variation; association/invariance not cultural causation.
layersConsidered.ENV: Natural-image study contrasts visual contents, not actual setting; no source-Layer substitution.
layersConsidered.INS: Institutional defaults/rules change choice architecture; preference/permission not automatic.
layersConsidered.INF: Gain/loss framing, probability descriptions, future cues and default information; exposure and mental uptake separate.
layersConsidered.TEC: Preselection interface and displayed cues; design operation not guaranteed latent valuation effect.

domainsConsidered.DELIBERATE_INTERVENTION: Future-event cueing and default preselection identities; effects RN after exact-measure review.
domainsConsidered.ROUTINE_UNINTENDED_HUMAN_ACTIVITY: Outcome experience, sampling, comparison and habitual default acceptance; selection and recency alternatives.
domainsConsidered.EXTERNAL_EVENT_SHOCK: Unexpected gains/losses/context disruption plausible, no exact causal protocol/endpoint retained.
domainsConsidered.ENVIRONMENTAL_EXPOSURE: Natural-scene imagery evidence not actual nature exposure or enduring trait effect.
domainsConsidered.INSTITUTIONAL_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: Default rules/options affect opportunity and uptake; no automatic preference or welfare.
domainsConsidered.TECHNOLOGICAL_CHANGE: Choice interfaces/preselection and cue display, no recommendation permission.
domainsConsidered.SOCIAL_NETWORK_EVENT_PROCESS: Social comparison/endorsement considered; no network metric, RDS or state-target shortcut.
domainsConsidered.INFORMATIONAL_EXPOSURE: Descriptions, frames, event cues, probability information and images; actual exposure required.
domainsConsidered.BIOLOGICAL_PHYSIOLOGICAL_PROCESS: Dopaminergic drug and affect literature; no dosing guidance, trait conversion or BIO-F01 work.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Existing INF-044 revision review only; no loss-aversion decrease from framing a risky choice.
driverLedgers.gaps: Loss/gain utility fitting needs reference, units and model; choice changes may alter beliefs or reference without altering loss-aversion parameter.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Reach, subgroups, unintended consequences, autonomy, risks and interaction considered; no generic benefit, synergy, antagonism, null equivalence or practitioner permission.

driverLedgers.noFinding: No uniform sign across probability range; FUNCTIONAL_SHAPE allowed for Driver but exact parameter/pointwise scope not established. No numerical execution.

driverLedgers.qualifiers: Reach, subgroups, unintended consequences, autonomy, risks and interaction considered; no generic benefit, synergy, antagonism, null equivalence or practitioner permission.

driverLedgers.noFinding: No exact canonical ambiguity-aversion manipulation retained; not universal aversion or intolerance scale identity.
driverLedgers.gaps: Ambiguity level and domain-specific attitude differ; learning probabilities changes exposure, not necessarily aversion.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Reach, subgroups, unintended consequences, autonomy, risks and interaction considered; no generic benefit, synergy, antagonism, null equivalence or practitioner permission.

driverLedgers.noFinding: EA0018 RN pending exact rate/curve specification: positive local discounting evidence retained, no whole-construct universal decrease. LEVEL of intrinsic rate differs from RATE-of-change.
driverLedgers.gaps: Fitted rate, indifference points and AUC differ. Rung2019 tests two local indifference points rather than a uniquely identified full rate/curve.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Reach, subgroups, unintended consequences, autonomy, risks and interaction considered; no generic benefit, synergy, antagonism, null equivalence or practitioner permission.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Canonical beta scale is preserved but directional convention flagged. Trait association and delay discounting do not prove trait→present-bias causality.
driverLedgers.gaps: Conventional beta parameter falls as present bias rises; explicit coding convention required. A two-option now-later task does not separately identify beta and long-run delta.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Reach, subgroups, unintended consequences, autonomy, risks and interaction considered; no generic benefit, synergy, antagonism, null equivalence or practitioner permission.

driverLedgers.noFinding: No exact whole-rate effect or dopaminergic causal Driver inferred from PET association; prescription/clinical use outside scope.
driverLedgers.gaps: Physical/cognitive effort costs depend on reward, baseline/comparator and task ability; drug/PET study estimates choices not broad executive capacity.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Reach, subgroups, unintended consequences, autonomy, risks and interaction considered; no generic benefit, synergy, antagonism, null equivalence or practitioner permission.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Heterogeneous null/positive choice-overload findings do not support universal direct conflict or task-difficulty identity.
driverLedgers.gaps: Choice overload studies use satisfaction/confidence/regret/deferral; these are not interchangeable latent conflict measures.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Reach, subgroups, unintended consequences, autonomy, risks and interaction considered; no generic benefit, synergy, antagonism, null equivalence or practitioner permission.

driverLedgers.noFinding: EA0019 RN: strong default-choice literature is not sufficient evidence for exact subjective preference or practitioner permission.
driverLedgers.gaps: Selection can result from ease, inertia, endorsement or cost without independent preference change; latent construct must be separately aligned.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Reach, subgroups, unintended consequences, autonomy, risks and interaction considered; no generic benefit, synergy, antagonism, null equivalence or practitioner permission.

propertyPolicy: All eleven properties considered. LEVEL of intrinsic discount rate differs from RATE of its temporal change. Probability function may need FUNCTIONAL_SHAPE/pointwise scope; no numeric graph weighting. No universal effect or supported null forced.
relationshipPropertyReview: All four exact incident records reviewed first. Reference/affect interactions not independently identified exact-edge moderation; no B/C duplicate contribution, formal pathway or relationship-targeted effect.

skepticalReview.method: Separate primary-versus-synthesis and construct-versus-estimator second pass; attempted falsification of framing, default and EFT claims.
checks: Default average, null and reverse choice effects retained without latent preference inference.
EFT cue-absent nondetection and control horizon contraction retained; indifference points do not uniquely determine full discount rate.
Probability curves can cross; no universal sign, causal weight or hidden direct RDS effect.
Beta coding direction for present bias flagged, no canonical scale change.
SRC205 wrong DOI independently resolved; F14 consultation pending, no canonical repair.
Cross-country preference associations, PET synthesis association and image content not relabeled causal cultural/BIO/ENV Drivers.
Prior F05 fear/anger reviews reused and not generalized; review-primary/dataset overlaps not replications.
skepticalReview.remainingRisks: Exact discount-rate measurement specification, default subjective-preference alignment and source-alignment backlog; both effects remain RN.
